slides.title: Home care agency horror story, told in texts
"When does Maria's CPR card expire?"
slides.body: "It's on the spreadsheet." The spreadsheet says: ask Dana. Dana left in March.

slides.title: "And her driver's license?"
slides.body: She drives clients to appointments. Nobody knows.

slides.title: "Also, the state surveyor is in the lobby."
slides.body: Asking for caregiver files. Right now.

slides.title: The scariest thing in a home care office
slides.body: is a date nobody wrote down. CPR cards, driver's licenses, auto insurance, agency license. Save this.
